gui.talesloader.no_trusted: Nobody but the owner may use this loader.
message.talesloader.break_denied: Only %s may break this chunk loader.
message.talesloader.owner_only: Only the owner may change access.
message.talesloader.chunk_taken: That chunk is already loaded by another chunk loader.
message.talesloader.center_locked: The loader's own chunk is always active.

command.talesloader.list_empty: No chunk loaders in this dimension.
talesloader.goggles.title: Chunk Loader
block.talesloader.chunk_loader.tooltip.s: Keeps up to _nine chunks_ loaded while it burns _fuel_. Admin issued, no recipe.
block.talesloader.chunk_loader.tooltip.b: Its own chunk stays loaded. Neighbouring chunks are toggled in the interface.
Only players can insert it. Every active chunk raises consumption.
block.talesloader.chunk_loader.tooltip.a: Rotates the housing. Sneaking picks the loader up, fuel included.
talesloader.ponder.chunk_loader.text_1: The Chunk Loader keeps the area around it loaded, even with no player nearby
talesloader.ponder.chunk_loader.text_2: Right-click it to open its interface
talesloader.ponder.chunk_loader.text_3: Its 3x3 grid shows the surrounding chunks - each one can be switched on separately
talesloader.ponder.chunk_loader.text_4: A running loader glows. Chunks already claimed by someone else stay locked
talesloader.ponder.chunk_loader_fuel.tex: Fuel goes into the slot in the interface - by hand only
Hoppers, droppers and pipes cannot insert anything
Every active chunk raises the consumption, so runtime drops the more chunks are loaded
Out of fuel the loader shuts down and releases its chunks - the owner gets a message
